debt.text: Finnie pledges to protect Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid benefits from cuts.

schools.text: Finnie calls for investment in public education.

abortion.text: Finnie says women should have the right to make their own healthcare decisions.

health.text: Finnie supports restoring enhanced Affordable Care Act assistance and creating a public insurance option.
